typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Event Date} as string,
		{Breach Status} as string,
		{External ID} as string,
		{Event ID} as string,
		{Notification SLA} as string,
		{Notification Time(EST)} as string,
		{Issued Time(EST)} as string,
		{Lapsed Time(EST)} as string,
		{Action Movement} as string,
		{Call Status} as string,
		{Interface Status} as string,
		{Distribution Medium} as string,
		{Statement Status} as string,
		Region as string,
		{Issuing User} as string,
		{Colline Comments} as string,
		{Custom Tech Comments} as string,
		{Agreement Requirement} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource derive() ~> FlatFileSourceErrorReformat
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of Region} = Region) ~> DataConversion
FlatFileSourceErrorReformat derive() ~> FlatFileSource0
DataConversion sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		External_ID as string,
		Statement_Status as string,
		Notification_SLA as string,
		Breach_Status as string,
		Notification_Time_EST_ as string,
		Colline_Comments as string,
		Custom_Tech_Comments as string,
		Issuing_User as string,
		Event_ID as string,
		Lapsed_Time_EST_ as string,
		Agreement_Requirement as string,
		Issued_Time_EST_ as string,
		Distribution_Medium as string,
		Interface_Status as string,
		Action_Movement as string,
		Region as string,
		Event_Date as string,
		Call_Status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		External_ID = {Copy of External ID},
		Statement_Status = {Copy of Statement Status},
		Notification_SLA = {Copy of Notification SLA},
		Breach_Status = {Copy of Breach Status},
		Notification_Time_EST_ = {Copy of Notification Time(EST)},
		Colline_Comments = {Copy of Colline Comments},
		Custom_Tech_Comments = {Copy of Custom Tech Comments},
		Issuing_User = {Copy of Issuing User},
		Event_ID = {Copy of Event ID},
		Lapsed_Time_EST_ = {Copy of Lapsed Time(EST)},
		Agreement_Requirement = {Copy of Agreement Requirement},
		Issued_Time_EST_ = {Copy of Issued Time(EST)},
		Distribution_Medium = {Copy of Distribution Medium},
		Interface_Status = {Copy of Interface Status},
		Action_Movement = {Copy of Action Movement},
		Region = {Copy of Region},
		Event_Date = {Copy of Event Date},
		Call_Status = {Copy of Call Status}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
FlatFileSource0 sink(input(
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn()) ~> FlatFileSource01
